items.html: And it is found that all the discernments of the judgments are hairs, and all of them are from the NH, where the Gevura is the recognition of the judgments, as above. And when they rise in the secret of the reflected light, which are the secret of the Gevurot, they strike three places, and they are the three heads of AA: the skull, the air, and the brain. And they mingle in all of them, and from all of them go out the thirteen bright strands [Chivaret], and the thirteen strands [Nimin], and the thirteen corrections of the beard, and all of them are from the aspect of the NH mentioned, except that according to their mingling in these three heads their names change, since they mingle with the lights of the three heads and come out together. For although all is from the aspect of the NH, as mentioned, nevertheless the thirteen bright strands are also from the lights of the skull, and the thirteen strands are in the air, and the thirteen corrections of the beard from the brain, for also from the three heads go out the aforementioned lights as well.
